questions.q: What causes post-glacial isostatic rebound in a region after a thick ice sheet melts?
o: The crust continues to sink because the ice becomes heavier
The depressed lithosphere slowly rises as the ice load is removed
The mantle permanently solidifies beneath the ice
Ocean tides pull the crust upward each day
questions.e: A heavy ice sheet depresses the crust and displaces mantle material. After the ice retreats, the reduced load allows the lithosphere to rise gradually, a process called glacial isostatic adjustment.

Percentage change in tax revenue divided by percentage change in nominal GDP

questions.q: What is the population variance of the data set 2, 4, 6 and 8?
questions.e: The mean is (2+4+6+8)/4 = 5. The squared deviations are 9, 1, 1 and 9, whose sum is 20; dividing by the population size 4 gives variance 5.

questions.q: A data set has a mean of 50 and a standard deviation of 5. What is its coefficient of variation?
questions.e: Coefficient of variation = (standard deviation ÷ mean) × 100. Here (5 ÷ 50) × 100 = 10%, which expresses dispersion relative to the mean.

questions.q: What is the geometric mean of 4 and 16?
questions.e: For two positive values, the geometric mean is the square root of their product. Multiply 4 by 16 to get 64, then take the square root: √64 = 8. This is different from the arithmetic mean, which would be 10.

questions.q: What is the slope of the straight line passing through the points (2, 3) and (6, 11)?
questions.e: Slope = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁). Substituting gives (11 − 3)/(6 − 2) = 8/4 = 2, which measures the change in y for each unit change in x.

questions.q: A circle has radius 7 cm. What is the area of a 90-degree sector? Use π = 22/7.
questions.e: A 90-degree sector is one quarter of the full circle. Its area is (90/360) × π × 7² = 1/4 × 154 = 38.5 cm².

questions.q: A circle has circumference 44 cm. Using π = 22/7, what is its radius?
questions.e: Circumference C = 2πr. Rearranging gives r = C/(2π). Substituting 44 and 22/7 gives 44 ÷ (44/7) = 7 cm, so the radius is 7 centimetres.

questions.q: In how many distinct ways can five different people sit around a round table if rotations are considered the same arrangement?
questions.e: For n distinct people around a circle, rotations are equivalent, so the number of arrangements is (n−1)!. For five people this is 4! = 24.
